card: Adds unit and functional P2P test coverage for CompactSize deserialization values exceeding MAX_SIZE, while refactoring existing non-canonical tests and formatting serialization helpers. Previously, removing the MAX_SIZE boundary check would pass all tests, and non-deterministic hits during transaction fuzzing introduced noise in test coverage tracking. This ensures corrupt oversized message lengths are reliably tested at both the unit and P2P protocol layers. No dependencies.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes to the approach or scope.
evidence: Author notes that 'Removing the check would pass all tests' (description)
Author notes 'accidental non-deterministic coverage through tx-deser "fuzzing", which hurts coverage reports' citing corecheck discussion #219 (description)
problem: The check rejecting CompactSize values larger than MAX_SIZE lacks deterministic test coverage, meaning removing the check passes the test suite. In addition, sporadic hits during fuzz testing introduce non-deterministic noise into automated coverage reports.

risk.why: A mistake in the new tests could cause spurious CI failures, while production serialization behavior is unchanged.

scope_notes: The change to src/serialize.h is purely whitespace and brace formatting.
summary: Adds unit and functional P2P tests for CompactSize deserialization exceeding MAX_SIZE. It also refactors existing non-canonical CompactSize unit tests to use standard test framework matchers and applies clang-format cleanup to CompactSize serialization helpers in serialize.h.
